statement: AMD launched Helios, its first production rack-scale AI architecture (72 MI455X GPUs, 31TB HBM4, 2.9 exaFLOPS FP4 per rack), positioned as an answer to NVIDIA's NVL72.
why: A production rack-scale platform makes AMD a credible alternative supply to NVIDIA.

impact.mechanism: A new competitive rack-scale system expands alternative accelerator supply.

evidence.excerpt: AMD launched Helios, its first production rack-scale AI reference architecture and its answer to NVIDIA's NVL72 platforms.
